approval_text: Restrict the current formal quality-evaluation track to physical model batch size B=1.
Preserve the original cross-batch gate as FAILED; do not change its tolerance, results, or historical contract.
Permit B=1 Fast PPL only for configurations whose existing B=1 Q0 requirements are complete and passing.
Keep all quality margins, datasets, sample IDs, tokenization, cache-sensitive execution, and statistical rules unchanged.
Do not transfer B=1 quality qualification to B=2/4/8/16 performance.
